Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Includes Concert Director with same-PC next-bar rejoin, setlist preflight, timing reports and rehearsal. Shortcut Bars can cue saved FFXIV macros across the party.
Changelog: Shortcut Bars can cue saved FFXIV macros across the conductor’s party. Followers opt in for their current party.
